objects.name: totals
variables: It shows one row for each region, with a total column that is the sum of the amount of the orders whose status is paid.
It keeps the filter on the paid status and the group by region.
The object `rows` shows fewer than 600 rows.
notes: Totals are the paid amount sum for each region. Column names in the feed can change. When rows shows 600, read totals and give them to the user.
